5541f02545d26713.description: Müller's Solutions is looking for a certified SAP eInvoicing Consultant to implement SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) for Saudi ZATCA e-invoicing in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud. This is a remote role. Configure SAP DRC for ZATCA (Fatoora) Phase 2 clearance and reporting Manage onboarding, CSID and cryptographic certificate setup with ZATCA Work with FI and SD consultants on invoice content, tax data and output Test end-to-end e-invoice flows, handle rejections and support go-live Hands-on SAP DRC implementation experience in S/4HANA Public Cloud Valid SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition certification (Finance preferred) Strong knowledge of ZATCA Phase 2 requirements and Saudi VAT Experience working with FI and SD teams

556cda20e52ceabf.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أرمادا العالمية للمقاولات العامة عن رسام معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 و 5 سنوات، وهو مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل. سيقوم شاغل الوظيفة بإعداد المخططات التنفيذية التفصيلية وتنسيقها لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة في المشاريع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد المخططات التنفيذية التفصيلية (Shop Drawings) لجميع أعمال التشطيبات الداخلية والديكور، بما في ذلك الأسقف المستعارة، القواطع الجدارية، الأرضيات، التجاليد الخشبية والمعدنية، وتفاصيل الواجهات الداخلية. مطابقة وتنسيق المخططات المعمارية مع مخططات الكهروميكانيك (MEP Coordination) لتجنب أي تعارضات قبل وأثناء التنفيذ الميداني. رسم وإخراج تفاصيل التركيبات والتشطيبات الخاصة (Interior Details & Joinery) بما يتوافق مع متطلبات المكاتب والمباني الإدارية الحكومية. إعداد ومتابعة مخططات ما بعد التنفيذ (As-Built) وتقديمها للاعتماد النهائي. مراجعة وحصر الكميات وجداول التشطيبات والفرش بالتنسيق مع المكتب الفني ومهندسي الموقع. إدارة ومتابعة سجلات المخططات (Drawing Log) وتحديث الإصدارات المعتمدة ومشاركتها مع فرق العمل بالموقع. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الرسم المعماري. دقة متناهية وسرعة في إخراج التفاصيل التنفيذية وحل التعارضات الفنية. قدرة عالية على قراءة وتحليل المخططات المعمارية ومطابقتها مع المخططات الإلكتروميكانيكية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل وتنسيق فعالة مع مهندسي الموقع والمكتب الفني. الالتزام بالمواعيد المحددة للتسليم. القدرة على التعامل مع ضغط متطلبات تسليم المشاريع. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة أرمادا العالمية للمقاولات العامة. يتطلب الدور التنسيق المستمر مع فرق العمل في الموقع والمكتب الفني. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

5513d824e9d3c3bd.description: About Geidea Established in 2008, Geidea provides digital payment solutions. The company focuses on continuous innovation to empower businesses with accessible payment technologies. Geidea aims to support businesses of all sizes and maturity levels by leveraging creative and entrepreneurial talent to deliver smart, innovative, and forward-thinking solutions. The Role: Sales Representative Geidea is seeking a full-time Sales Representative to join its team in Dammam, Eastern region. This role is central to executing the sales plan, driving revenue by attracting new merchants, and maintaining strong relationships with both new and existing clients. The Sales Representative acts as the frontline contact, addressing merchant feedback directly or through internal stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain relationships between Geidea and its clients. Conduct field visits to acquire new business for Geidea. Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly, and yearly revenue targets in the designated area, covering both acquisition and Total Payment Volume (TPV). Respond to customer feedback and channel it to relevant stakeholders via the direct manager. Prepare quotations, address objections, and follow up to close deals. Prospect for new business through in-person, telephone, and email communication, contacting decision-makers to present Geidea's products, services, and solutions. Qualifications and Requirements 0-2 years of relevant experience preferred. Bachelor’s degree in any field. Fintech background is preferred. Geidea's Core Values Geidea operates based on a set of core values that guide its approach and actions: Customer first: Integrated into design thinking and customer service. Open: Fosters continuous improvement and evolution. Real: Emphasizes directness and accountability. Bold: Encourages challenging existing thoughts and methods. Resilient: Focuses on learning and recovering from setbacks. Collaborative: Believes in achieving more through teamwork. Application Information This full-time position offers an opportunity to contribute to a company focused on developing better solutions in the fintech sector. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

55baf82ee22b210a.job_title: Design & Project Manager Real Estate Development
55baf82ee22b210a.description: About ROSHN ROSHN, a prominent national real estate developer in Saudi Arabia, is dedicated to creating integrated communities that enhance the quality of life for residents. As a giga-project supported by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), ROSHN plays a significant role in the Kingdom's Vision 2030 by delivering high-quality residential and mixed-use developments. The Role of Analyst, Development Management The Analyst, Development Management supports the planning, coordination, and successful delivery of real estate development projects. This full-time position is based in Saudi Arabia and is suitable for professionals with 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Apply development management principles and practices to support various project phases. Assist with feasibility studies and business case development. Support design management and the process of obtaining authority approvals. Contribute to budgeting, scheduling, and risk management activities. Aid in project reporting to ensure clear communication of progress and issues. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, consultants, authorities, and delivery partners. Monitor project progress and assist in resolving issues to maintain project timelines. Help ensure projects align with business objectives, quality standards, budget requirements, and stakeholder expectations. Required Experience Candidates for this role should possess 0-1 years of experience, demonstrating a foundational understanding of real estate development processes and project management principles. The position is ideal for an individual looking to grow their career in development management within a dynamic environment. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will work within ROSHN's project teams, contributing to significant real estate developments across the Kingdom. Application Process If you meet the qualifications and are interested in contributing to ROSHN's mission, please submit your application. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

55cdea8d7d7aa779.description: About the Role Qualified Crew is seeking a Project Manager, Civil Engineering, to lead civil construction projects in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing projects from the initial planning stages through to handover, combining day-to-day project delivery with direct responsibility for financial and contractual aspects. Key Responsibilities Lead civil construction projects from planning to handover. Manage day-to-day project delivery operations. Handle project billing and progress invoicing. Process and manage variation orders. Manage formal contract correspondence. Coordinate effectively with clients, consultants, and site teams. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering. A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in civil construction. Demonstrated experience in leading project delivery. Hands-on experience with project billing, progress invoicing, variation orders, and formal contract correspondence. Required Skills Strong verbal communication skills. Strong written communication skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with various stakeholders including clients, consultants, and site teams. Availability Preference will be given to candidates who are available to join immediately or have a short notice period. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

55d33e07146881de.description: About KBR KBR is a company driven by innovators, thinkers, creators, explorers, volunteers, and dreamers, all united by the goal of improving the world responsibly and safely. The company attracts a diverse workforce and top talent globally, fostering an environment where expertise thrives on creativity, resourcefulness, and collaboration. The Role of Insulation Supervisor KBR is seeking an Insulation Supervisor to oversee and execute the removal and repair of hot and cold insulation. This full-time position requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in insulation work within industrial settings. Key Responsibilities Apply, remove, and repair insulation on industrial equipment, pipes, ductwork, and other mechanical systems within SATORP Plants. Determine the necessary amounts and types of insulation, along with installation methods, considering factors such as location, surface shape, and equipment use. Install sheet metal around insulated pipes using screws to protect the insulation from weather conditions or physical damage. Prepare surfaces for insulation application, including brushing or spreading adhesives. Select appropriate insulation materials, such as fiberglass, Styrofoam, or cork, based on their heat retaining or excluding characteristics. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in insulation supervision or a related field. Demonstrated awareness of Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) rules. Proper knowledge of plant hazard materials. Proficiency in the use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). Work Type This is a full-time position.

5521eeb682e0f70e.description: About the Role Nice One is seeking a Graphic Designer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on creating effective visual communications that support the company’s brand, marketing, and business objectives. The Graphic Designer will develop and deliver design assets across digital and print channels, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure work is consistent, polished, and suited to its intended audience. Key Responsibilities Create visual assets for marketing campaigns, websites, social media, presentations, advertising, and other business needs. Apply brand guidelines consistently across design work and help maintain a cohesive visual identity across channels. Develop concepts, layouts, and design solutions that communicate key messages and meet project objectives. Produce graphics and other visual content for websites, email, social media, digital advertising, and related platforms. Prepare layouts and production-ready files for printed materials such as brochures, flyers, signage, packaging, and collateral. Partner with Marketing, Communications, Product, and other teams to understand requirements and deliver appropriate creative work. Manage multiple design projects, timelines, and priorities, communicating progress and raising potential delays or challenges. Present design concepts, incorporate feedback, and revise work while maintaining quality and alignment with project goals. Review designs for accuracy, legibility, technical specifications, and visual consistency before delivery or publication. Organize and maintain design files, templates, and approved brand assets for efficient team access and reuse. Stay current with design trends, production practices, and creative software relevant to the role. Identify opportunities to improve creative workflows, design quality, and the effectiveness of visual communications. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, or a related field; equivalent education and relevant experience may be considered. Experience creating visual assets for digital and print applications. Proficiency with graphic design software such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, or comparable tools. Working knowledge of typography, color, layout, image editing, and visual composition. Knowledge of file preparation and production requirements for digital and print deliverables. A portfolio demonstrating design skills, creative problem-solving, and attention to detail. Ability to manage concurrent projects and meet deadlines in a collaborative work environment. Work Type This is a full-time position.

55403d423dbdad72.description: About the Role Tas'Helat Marketing is seeking a Maintenance Planner to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the Regional Maintenance Engineer in achieving regional objectives and planning preventive maintenance activities. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Manage all job orders from opening to closing, including archiving and recording. Manage and update SLA contracts. Maintain and update the log of maintenance assets as and when required. Prepare and update maintenance-related reports, including KPI. Process payments and other business-related documents. Analyse and track regional and individual performance, communicating findings to the Regional Maintenance Engineer through standard reports. Maintain records of tools and resources, including inventory of spare parts. Support the regional team in administrative work. Support the Maintenance Engineer in planning spare parts and other required resources. Maintain a register and record of all staff certifications and other benefits. Ensure that HSSE policies and procedures are followed and work is carried out safely. Support the Maintenance Engineer in preparing the annual maintenance budget (CAPEX and OPEX), monitoring maintenance expenses, and developing best-practice procedures. Support implementation of the work permit system, PPE requirements, and best-practice procedures to ensure staff and property safety. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s or associate degree in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or an equivalent discipline. Minimum 1-2 years’ experience in the Oil & Gas industry preferred, or FMCG, with a minimum of 3 years as a team lead. Required Skills Ability to work under pressure and foster team spirit. Strong organisational skills and ability to plan and manage time effectively. Technical knowledge and analytical skills. Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, and PowerPoint. Knowledge of SAP or any other ERP system is preferred. Good command of English and strong communication skills. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Candidates meeting the above requirements are encouraged to apply.

554ae4870fee0d7a.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking a Financial Controller to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role is responsible for overseeing financial planning, analysis, and management within a specific division, ensuring alignment with the organization's overall financial strategy. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience and involves providing financial insights, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation guidance to support strategic decision-making and operational efficiency. Key Accountabilities Develop financial strategies that support business growth and sustainability. Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning processes. Monitor key financial metrics and business performance, analyzing variances and recommending actions to improve margins and cost efficiency. Provide financial insights for pricing, investments, and operational decisions, including building business cases and conducting scenario modeling. Identify and implement cost-saving initiatives and ensure optimal allocation of financial resources. Maintain strong internal controls, ensure regulatory compliance, and coordinate with audit, tax, and legal teams to manage financial risks. Deliver accurate and timely financial reports to leadership, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights. Leadership and Management Responsibilities Recruit, recognize, and cultivate high performers to create a robust second line of management. Address low performance through guidance or necessary action, ensuring fair treatment of subordinates based on performance. Ensure the availability of a delegation of authority matrix in line with company policy. Operational Accountability Take full responsibility for operations as per the job description and deliverables, adhering to company guidelines. Anticipate problems and take proactive steps to prevent them, making timely and proper decisions. Deliver required results in a timely manner with specified quality and cost. Make a tangible difference in the area of operation, exceeding business expectations. Business Planning and Development Transform corporate goals into business plans, and effectively plan, follow up, and execute annual and development plans. Monitor plan performance, initiate actions to strengthen results, and take corrective measures. Provide periodic work progress reports and control budgets and expenses for optimum cost efficiency. Develop the organizational structure based on current and future requirements. Ensure the availability and deployment of job descriptions for all roles. Develop and coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, and procedures, seeking automation opportunities. Navigate and promote IT solutions relevant to the job and business, fostering a culture of automated system usage. Quality and Adaptation Uphold quality as Alfanar's prime competitive advantage. Adapt to new and alternative techniques, technologies, management structures, and business models. Ensure a safe, secure, and legal work environment in accordance with standard regulations.

5566b32fd0c23a5c.description: About KBR and the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Senior Planner to join its Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) division. This full-time position is based in the Makkah region, specifically covering locations such as Rabigh and Makkah. KBR STS delivers comprehensive solutions across the entire asset lifecycle, including licensed process technologies, advisory services, technical expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions for optimizing assets. Role Overview The Senior Planner will be responsible for preparing and developing maintenance plans on a weekly and monthly basis. These plans will encompass preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance activities across mechanical, electrical, instrument, and general services. The role requires ensuring proper resource allocation and coordination with various stakeholders to facilitate the timely execution of maintenance schedules. Key Responsibilities Prepare weekly and monthly routine and preventive maintenance plans, including all related activities. Ensure adequate resource planning and sourcing for the implementation and completion of planned maintenance activities according to schedule. Analyze and record critical operational and maintenance issues affecting SATORP’s equipment, plants, and utilities availability. Liaise and participate in meetings and analyses with other Divisions to develop maintenance plans and schedules, providing technical inputs and recommendations as required. Coordinate with the CET Division to evaluate progress against plans and conduct technical studies to identify and recommend new practices for planning and implementation activities. Coordinate with all applicable Stakeholders to ensure the availability of maintenance personnel, materials, spare parts, tools, and equipment for job execution. Prepare and maintain statistical maintenance and technical reports related to routine and preventive maintenance activities at SATORP. Utilize SAP systems, computer programs, and software for the effective implementation of routine and preventive maintenance plans. Assist in preparing, developing, and measuring Contractor’s Key Performance Indicators. Maintain all historical records and databases of routine and preventive maintenance plans. Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Compliance Ensure compliance with all HSE rules. Encourage the reporting of unsafe acts and conditions. Comply with all SHE procedures prior to commencement and during work. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this Senior Planner role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in maintenance planning within industrial settings. Proficiency in utilizing SAP systems and other relevant computer programs for maintenance planning is essential.

552fadf7dbaa23db.description: About the Role Haji Husein Alireza & Co. Ltd. is seeking a Sales Coordinator to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves coordinating sales unit activities, managing customer relations, and supporting branch and showroom managers with clerical and logistical tasks. The Sales Coordinator will also be responsible for monitoring sales performance against market trends and preparing regular reports. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with the sales unit and customer relation management, adhering to company policies and procedures. Provide clerical and logistical support to the Branch Manager and Showroom Manager. Conduct vehicle reservations and cancellations in coordination with the Logistics Department and Stockyard as needed. Prepare customer invoices and warranties in coordination with the Logistics Department. Update pending and sold deals within the filing system and train the sales team on filing procedures. Prepare and update weekly walk-in follow-up reports in coordination with sales executives. Gather acquired sales reports, survey sales movement against the market, and prepare monthly sales forecasts and reports. Prepare invoices and update information on sold and lost deals. Perform calculations, generate quotations, process transfer requests, and manage cheque receipts. Offer ideas and suggestions to contribute to sales development and constructive perceptions. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of a Secondary Certificate. Minimum of 3 years of experience in a similar field. Required Skills Excellent oral and written communication skills in both English and Arabic. Good communication and negotiation skills with customers. Good knowledge of modern sales methods. Ability to complete sales documents efficiently. Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Ability to maintain composure in challenging situations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, requiring coordination across various sales and logistics units.

55ba86308ed17517.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة عبدالرحمن عبدالله محمد اليوسف للتجارة عن مدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يشارك شاغل هذا الدور في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، ويشرف على تخطيط وتنظيم الأعمال الإدارية لضمان سير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة وفعالية عالية، مع توفير الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. التأكد من وجود الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لمتابعة مستوى تحقيق الخطط والأهداف الإدارية. الإشراف على عمليات تطوير جداول الصلاحيات الإدارية والإجراءات المتبعة، ومراجعتها باستمرار لتحسينها وضمان تقديم الخدمات الإدارية بالجودة والسرعة المطلوبة. متابعة وتوجيه أنشطة تلبية احتياجات الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين من الخدمات الإدارية المختلفة، مثل النقل والضيافة والنظافة وتنظيم المراسلات والأرشفة والتشغيل الإداري للمباني والمرافق. الإشراف على تطبيق الأنظمة والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية، وضمان إبلاغ الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين بكافة القرارات والتعليمات الصادرة عن الإدارة العليا ومتابعة تنفيذها. الإشراف على إعداد وتحضير الملخصات والتقارير التي توضح نسب الإنجاز العامة في الشؤون الإدارية، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا، وإحاطتهم بالتحديات والمستجدات، واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف الإدارية وتنفيذ الخطط. مهارات إشرافية وتنظيمية ممتازة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات التخطيط والتنظيم. القدرة على متابعة العمليات الإدارية وضمان كفاءتها. مهارات التواصل الفعال وإعداد التقارير. القدرة على إدارة الموارد البشرية والتقنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في الرياض. سيعمل المدير الإداري ضمن فريق المؤسسة لضمان سير العمليات الإدارية بسلاسة وفعالية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

55e49abc8bfdac87.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مدارس التربية الأهليه للبنات عن مرشد طلابي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم الطلاب أكاديميًا ونفسيًا وعاطفيًا، وتقديم الإرشاد اللازم لمساعدتهم على تجاوز التحديات المختلفة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإرشاد الطلابي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء علاقات ثقة وتواصل فعال مع الطلاب لتحديد المشكلات النفسية والعاطفية والتربوية (التحصيل الدراسي) في مراحلها المبكرة واستكشاف أسبابها الجذرية. التعاون مع الهيئة التدريسية لمساعدة الطلاب على فهم مشكلاتهم وأسبابها، والعمل بشكل مشترك لإيجاد الحلول المناسبة وكيفية التغلب عليها. مراجعة سجلات علامات الطلاب لتحديد ذوي التحصيل المتدني، والعمل على كشف أسباب تدني التحصيل وصعوبات التعلم، ثم التعاون مع الهيئة التدريسية لتقديم دروس تقوية للطلاب الذين يواجهون هذه الصعوبات. التواصل الفعال مع أولياء الأمور بشأن تقدم الطلاب أو إحالة الحالات الصعبة إلى الاختصاصيين عند الضرورة. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة في مجال الإرشاد الطلابي وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة لذلك لضمان سهولة الرجوع إليها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الإرشاد الطلابي. القدرة على دراسة المشكلات النفسية والعاطفية والتربوية للطلاب وتقديم الدعم اللازم. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لبناء علاقات إيجابية مع الطلاب وأولياء الأمور والهيئة التدريسية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة بدقة. بيئة العمل يعمل المرشد الطلابي ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة في مدارس التربية الأهليه للبنات بالخبر. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع الطلاب والمعلمين والإدارة لضمان تقديم أفضل دعم إرشادي. التقديم ندعو المرشحين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذا الدور إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

5524c506921b771a.description: About My Clinic My Clinic is a leading multispecialty outpatient care provider in Saudi Arabia, established in 2017. The organization focuses on delivering healthcare services through innovation and a commitment to care, collaboration, ambition, and responsibility. My Clinic aims to help individuals achieve longer, healthier, and happier lives. The Role of Information Security Manager My Clinic is seeking an Information Security Manager to lead its information and cybersecurity program. This full-time position, located in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, focuses on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) to protect sensitive patient data and ensure adherence to cybersecurity regulations. The role involves developing and executing security and risk management strategies, managing the information security team, and collaborating with IT and business leadership to safeguard data while maintaining operational integrity. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and maintain information security and data protection policies, procedures, and guidelines in alignment with industry standards (CIS, NIST, NCA) and regulatory requirements, including KSA’s Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL). Lead enterprise-wide risk assessments to identify, analyze, and prioritize cybersecurity and data protection risks. Develop and maintain a risk register, implement mitigation strategies, and monitor treatment plans. Oversee outsourced Security Operations Center (SOC) activities, ensuring effective monitoring, detection, and response to cybersecurity threats. Review KPIs, evaluate incident handling processes, and align SOC activities with security objectives. Ensure organizational compliance with cybersecurity frameworks (CIS, NIST, NCA) and data protection regulations (PDPL). Conduct regular compliance reviews to meet requirements from bodies such as SDAIA and NCA. 55227f084049d1dc.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Senior Project / Cost Controls Engineer (Commercial/ Internal) to join its team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, covering both Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role requires over 10 years of experience and focuses on providing comprehensive project controls support across various financial and operational aspects of projects. Role Overview and Responsibilities The Senior Project / Cost Controls Engineer will manage cost, schedule, risk, revenue, margin, cash flow, and change management. The position involves establishing reliable project baselines, converting operational data into accurate forecasts and P&L insights, and supporting timely risk management decisions throughout the project lifecycle. This role operates with a high degree of independence while ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, internal governance, and established project controls processes. Develop and maintain project budgets, cost breakdown structures, and Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), aligning them with scope, schedule, procurement strategy, resource plans, and contractual deliverables. Prepare monthly forecasts including estimate to complete (ETC), estimate at completion (EAC), revenue, gross profit, margin, cash flow, and headcount assumptions, explaining material variances. Track commitments, actual costs, accruals, and forecast costs, identifying unfavorable trends and recommending corrective actions. Apply Earned Value Management (EVM) principles and other performance-measurement techniques to evaluate cost and schedule performance. Support appropriate revenue recognition methods, prepare and validate accruals, and ensure accurate monthly reporting. Interpret contractual and subcontract terms affecting revenue, margin, billing, cash collection, and risk allocation, escalating material commercial exposure. Identify, quantify, document, and track client and internal changes, ensuring reflection in project forecasts, risk registers, budgets, and schedules. Facilitate identification and assessment of project risks and opportunities, maintaining risk registers and monitoring contingency. Interpret payment terms, support accurate invoicing, forecast collections, and monitor accounts receivable and unbilled balances. Interpret project schedules, progress data, critical milestones, and resource requirements, assessing cost and commercial impact of schedule movement. Prepare concise dashboards and management reports covering cost, schedule, revenue, margin, cash, risks, opportunities, and changes. Partner with Project Directors, Project Managers, technical leads, Finance, Commercial, Contracts, and Procurement teams. Reconcile revenue, gross profit, final costs, commitments, and changes during project closeout. Required Skills and Qualifications Candidates must possess a strong foundation in project controls and financial acumen, coupled with analytical and communication abilities. Technical Project Controls: Strong knowledge of cost control, forecasting, budgeting, EVM, change control, risk management, cash flow, and performance reporting. Financial and Commercial Acumen: Ability to understand project P&L, revenue recognition, margin drivers, accruals, working capital, contract terms, and financial consequences of project decisions. Data and Systems: Advanced Microsoft Excel capability and practical experience producing clear Power BI dashboards. Working knowledge of project controls, scheduling, ERP, and cost-management systems is preferred. Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret complex data, challenge assumptions, identify trends and root causes, and translate analysis into clear actions. Accuracy and Governance: Strong attention to detail, disciplined documentation, and commitment to reliable, auditable, and timely reporting. Communication and Influence: Clear written and verbal communication, with the confidence to explain financial and project-control issues to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Desired Attributes Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across project, technical, commercial, finance, and leadership teams while maintaining constructive challenge and accountability. Prioritization and Adaptability: Ability to manage competing deadlines, respond to changing project conditions, and maintain reporting quality in a demanding environment. Problem-Solving: Practical approach to resolving complex project-controls issues, closing data gaps, and developing proportionate recovery or mitigation actions. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities extending to projects in Jeddah. The role involves close collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders, requiring a proactive and independent approach to project controls.

553e6352fb0d5267.description: Job description Stage - Transfert et validation d'un modèle de comportement CMC multi-échelle F/H Stage 5 à 6 mois Etudiant Temps complet L'introduction des composites à matrice céramique (CMC) dans les moteurs d'avion est devenue une réalité et reste un enjeu majeur pour la prochaine génération de moteur. En effet, ces matériaux ont une très bonne tenue thermomécanique aux hautes températures et une faible densité. Ils sont donc les candidats idéaux pour remplacer les métaux dans les parties chaudes des moteurs d'avions et ainsi gagner en efficacité et réduire leur l'empreinte environnementale. Dans ce contexte, le groupe SAFRAN développe des technologies en CMC, reposant sur plusieurs familles de matériau. La mise au point du matériau et son intégration dans les pièces de turbine nécessitent un appui fort de la modélisation. Du fait de la grande complexité du matériau, des modèles multi-échelles ont été mis en place. L'objectif du stage est d'intégrer un code de calcul expert dans l'environnement numérique Safran et de valider son fonctionnement. Le stage se décompose en trois grandes phases : - Intégration du modèle sur le cluster de calcul - Optimisation de sa résilience dans l'environnement (Linux, Abaqus, Python) - Mise en œuvre sur des cas tests et d'intérêt Vous serez intégré-e au sein du département Matériaux et Essais. Vous serez amené-e à travailler en collaboration avec le département Calcul et Conception ainsi qu'avec d'autres sociétés du groupe Safran et le Laboratoire des Composites Thermo-Structuraux (LCTS). Vous aurez également à faire le lien entre les simulations numériques et les résultats expérimentaux pour s'assurer de la cohérence de la simulation. Stage localisé au Haillan (33), quelques déplacements à prévoir sur Pessac (33), au laboratoire des Composites Thermo-structuraux (LCTS) Parlons de vous : Vous êtes étudiant-e en école d'ingénieur avec une spécialité en modélisation et mécanique des matériaux. Vous avez une bonne aisance dans les différents langages et environnements informatiques, ainsi qu'un esprit de synthèse pour documenter les travaux. Vous êtes rigoureuse ou rigoureux, méthodique, organisé-e et autonome, et avez un intérêt pour découvrir des domaines de recherche de pointe. Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever. What Is In It For You: This isn't just another performance marketing role. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting. Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%: Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales Great Place to Work Certified Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co-working space, (OR) our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location. 4. Become the Operator Other Brands Try to Hire In most companies, performance marketing leaders inherit a system somebody else built and spend the next three years defending its numbers in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides how much capital goes into growth next quarter, your model is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. 5585dc99b930c687.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية للأبنية، وتحديد المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الطارئة والدورية، بالإضافة إلى كيل الأعمال المنجزة وإعداد المطالبات المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قوائم بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز العمل. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية بشأن الأعمال المنجزة. كيل الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية والمواصفات. مهارات جيدة في إدارة الوقت وتنظيم المهام. بيئة العمل يُعد هذا الدور وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في صيانة المباني، ويوفر بيئة عمل داعمة لتحقيق الأهداف المهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

55ce1b19efcfba6f.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن حاجتها لـ مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق في المنشأة، بالإضافة إلى تخطيط جداول أعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق الحالية والمستقبلية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، والإشراف على تطبيقها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية والتصاميم والأثاث. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق. الإشراف على أنشطة الصيانة وتنسيق عمليات التصليح لتقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم، ومراقبة أدائهم وسلوكهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء ومراجعتها والموافقة عليها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بإدارة المرافق أو الأشغال العامة. القدرة على تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق بفعالية. معرفة قوية بإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل مدير الأشغال والمرافق العامة ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة عالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة المهنية في شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل.
